5.56x45mm MiniFix.info: Swap your caliber to 5.56x45mm. Increases performance overall, but reduces penetration. Extreme headshot multiplier.

MP5 Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster. Easier to control recoil.

30rd Mag.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold 30 rounds. Reduced total spare rounds carried, slower reload and walkspeed.

Snail MiniFix.info:
Swap your standard capacity magazine for a 90-round drum.
A heavy magazine to fill your needs of never having to reload again... until you need to!

MAC-11 Buffer M.info:
A medium buffer for your MAC-11!
Moderately increases fire rate but lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

MAC-10 Buffer M.info:
A medium buffer for your MAC-10!
Moderately increases fire rate but lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

e Shotgun HDS.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for home defence scenarios.
Weapon is locked to burst fire with adjusted performance.

Heavy Buffer.info: A heavier buffer spring that helps to reduce rate of fire and recoil, making a gun more controllable.

35rd Box Mag.info: A Zarovian designated 35-round box magazine that originally came with the PPSH-41. Increases general mobility due to it's lighter weight, and recoil will be a bit easier to control.

Straight Pull Bolt.info:
Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all your chakras.
Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, can cycle freely, have a lot less weapon sway and can hold breath for longer while scoping.
Your zen state, however, reduces your aim walkspeed, aim speed and equip/unequip speed!

M16 Burst Trigger Group.info: Change the trigger group of your M16A3 to fire in 3-round burst and semi-automatic, making it an M16A2. Improves weapon damage and performance at long range.

FAMAS G2 Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your FAMAS F1 with those of the FAMAS G2 assault rifle.
Increases RPM by 200 and grants a 30-round stanag magazine, but damage is lowered, reload and aim is slower. Hipfire is a little worse.

MP-9 Remove Limiter.info:
Removes the fire rate limiter from your MP-9 allowing it to fire at the full 1500 RPM!
Results in less accuracy and is not compatible with the drum magazine.

Five-Seven Full Auto.info: An aftermarket modification turning the gun into a full-auto machine gun - at the cost of rapidly dumping the contents of the magazine after pulling the trigger.

FIVE-0 Full-Auto Trigger Group.info: Change the trigger group of your FIVE-0 to make it fire in full-automatic and semi-automatic. Lowers your firerate, ranges, and increases recoil somewhat.

Reduced MiniFix.info: Swap your standard capacity magazines for 20 round M16 magazines. Reduced capacity, increased overall handling!

Pro Mag.info:
A 50 round drum magazine for the Ruger 10/22, and by extension, the ZIP 22. Yeah, that's right, 50 rounds of .22 Long Rifle. Reduces mobility and aiming speed.
To have the pro mag, you must be a pro.

Gyrojet Full-Auto Conversion.info:
You ever wonder how the Grand Federation had made it to the moon? Rockets of course!
This fits your Gyrojet with the capability of firing in automatic. Trading off semi-auto performance for full-auto rocket power!

Heavy Bolt.info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one made by Beretta, slowing down the RPM and general mobility but makes the gun easier to control.

P90 Civvy Mag.info:
Despite looking like a typical P90 magazine this one can only hold thirty rounds and was made for the civilian market.
Less rounds in a magazine (obviously), but slightly better mobility and reload speed.

BWC9 Fire Selector Burst.info: Adds a fire selector to your BWC9. Capable of firing in 3 shot burst.

AUG Burst Group.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your UAR favoring a 3-round burst over full auto.
Slightly raises headshot and torso damage while also slightly reducing recoil.

AUG HBAR Closed Bolt Conversion.info: Convert your UAR HEAVY to fire from a closed bolt. Reduces weapon firerate and gives it more general accuracy in exchange. Can load an extra round in the chamber!

MAC-11 Buffer S.info:
A small buffer for your MAC-11!
Slightly increases fire rate but slightly lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!

Speedloader.info: A lightweight piece of kit that is perfect for making reloading revolvers a breeze. When you use all of your rounds in the cylinder, you can reload at a faster rate! However it comes at the cost of a slower reload when theres unspent rounds in the cylinder.

CS/LR Marksman Kit.info: Advanced marksman training allows you to channel your inner zen, aligning all of your chakras. Subsequently, you don't lose focus when aiming down sights, and can cycle freely. Your zen state, however, reduces your RPM.

Spring Mod.info: A spring modification that somehow miraculously doesn't jam every 2 shots, may have some unexpected side effects though.

Heavy Bolt (MG42).info: The bolt is replaced by a much heavier one, slowing down the RPM and movement but making the gun easier to control.

CSMG Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your XM633 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Making it by technicality, the M639 SMG. Easier to control recoil.

e Shotgun CCS.info:
Adjust your settings to be fit for crowd control scenarios.
Weapon is locked to automatic fire with adjusted performance.

TCR Duplex Binary.info: A binary-trigger group allows you to fire your gun on a trigger pull and to fire again once you let go. Duplex rounds not included.

BOOMBOX Semi Group.info:
Changes the trigger grouping of your Doombox to be semi-automatic only!
Raises headshot & torso damage but reduces fire rate allowing you to play it like a subsonic DMR!

GS Slam Fire.info: Allows your Golden Shorty to slam fire at a fast rate by holding down the firing button at the cost of larger spread!

DSR Remove Mag.info:
Removes the front magazine from your gun to lower its weight, increasing mobility while aiming and handling speed.
But this lowers your reserve ammo pool.

Light Bolt (MG42).info: The bolt is replaced by a much lighter one, increasing the RPM and some mobility but making the gun harder to control!

SKORP Rate Limiter.info: Removes the firerate limiter from your Skorpion machine pistol granting it to be fired faster. A drawback to removing the limiter will severely impact your weapons recoil.

SPAS-12 Pump-Action.info:
Switch the firemode to pump-action typically used for lower pressure rounds.
Better accuracy, worse RPM.
Free!

AUG DMR Burst Group.info: Adds a 3-round burst trigger group to the UAR A3M2 for a unique trigger control flavor.

M1919 Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your Thompson with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun.
Expect your firerate to go up, but your handling to drop extensively...

Trench Sweeper.info: Change your internals of your Typewriter with those of the experimental M1919 submachine gun. Insanely high fire rate and improves your handling significantly but comes at the cost of a limited 30 round magazine and wild recoil!

MP5K Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9K to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage to torsos an damage overall giving more breathing room in range if you hit torso shots. Easier to control recoil.

MP5SD Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9SD to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance at further distances with damage dropping off slower. Generally easier to control recoil.

AA-12 Semi Conversion.info:
Change the internals of your AA-12 to make it able to fire in semi automatic like the closed-bolt civilian variant.
Better choke accuracy, but less rpm. Can carry an extra round in the chamber.

MP5/10 Burst Trigger Group.info:
Change the trigger group of your SMX-9/10 to fire in a 3-round burst and semi-automatic.
Improves weapon damage and performance in close range but damage drops off faster with poorer damage in range. Easier to control recoil.

50rd Drum.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold a whopping 50 rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

HCAR Open bolt.info: Converts your HCAR to be fully automatic but gives up the ability to shoot semi-automatic.

BWC9 Fire Selector Semi.info: Removes the fire selector making it the commercial BWC9.

MAC-11 Buffer L.info:
A large buffer for your MAC-11!
Largely increases fire rate but significantly lowers rotational damping and increases rising camera recoil!
